subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Should maintainers repair this member-authored PR as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback, or pause it in favor of another open candidate?
rationale: The issue is real, but this PR is dirty, has a concrete message/security fallback defect, and overlaps with other open candidate fixes, so automation cannot choose the canonical branch safely.

options.title: Repair This Branch First
options.body: Refresh this branch, narrow the upload predicate to insufficient-scope failures, preserve send metadata, and then do final maintainer review.

options.title: Choose A Sibling Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers select another open implementation that becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers all three runtime paths.

options.title: Accept The Broad Fallback Risk
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept all upload 403s as link fallbacks, but that should be an explicit security/message-delivery decision.

recommendation.title: Repair This Branch First
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch, narrow the upload predicate to insufficient-scope failures, preserve send metadata, and then do final maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: Most visible recent owner across the Google Chat API/media/action paths and likely best routing owner for canonical branch selection.
